summary: An opponent asks what would keep a proposed minimum charge from becoming a higher price.
realLife: Washington Senate report on SB 5323, 2019. Senate opponents objected that the minimum in the proposal they heard left the upper amount open.
inGame: needs: the version before the committee specifies a minimum charge.
gates: The version before the committee specifies a minimum charge.

turns.what: The amendment fixes a single charge.
turns.pulledBy: An amendment sets an exact amount.
turns.writesBack: The witness can point to the price in the revised draft.

turns.what: A shopper brings a receipt showing more than the minimum.
turns.pulledBy: The floor stays in place and the store posts a higher price.
turns.writesBack: The shopper's receipt supplies a concrete case for review.
